stories.title: Incidente stradale all'alba per Daniel Maldini, trovato positivo all'etilometro

en.title: Road accident at dawn for Daniel Maldini, found positive on breathalyzer
en.summary: Footballer Daniel Maldini was involved in a two-vehicle collision early morning and tested positive for alcohol with readings of 0.91 mg/l and 0.89 mg/l on consecutive breathalyzer tests. Maldini had played in an Atalanta-Cagliari match hours earlier.

stories.title: Intelligenza Artificiale, Trump: "Forze negative chiedono un rallentamento ma non succederà"

en.title: Artificial Intelligence, Trump: "Negative forces are asking for slowdown but it won't happen"
en.summary: Trump stated that despite calls from various parties, including major AI companies like OpenAI and Anthropic, to regulate artificial intelligence development, such slowdown will not occur. Obama urged Democrats to address the AI regulation issue.

en.title: Trump, 'negative forces want to slow down AI'
en.summary: The US president commented after major American technology companies issued warnings regarding artificial intelligence development.

stories.title: Bonino, folla per la camera ardente in Campidoglio: sul feretro la bandiera Ue. Domani la veglia

en.title: Bonino, crowds at lying-in-state at Campidoglio: EU flag on the coffin. Vigil tomorrow
en.summary: A lying-in-state ceremony for Bonino took place at Rome's Campidoglio with the EU flag draped over the coffin, attended by Rome's mayor Roberto Gualtieri and Più Europa secretary Riccardo Magi. A vigil is scheduled for the following day.

stories.title: Zelensky, 'deliberato attacco russo a treno al confine con Polonia'

en.title: Zelensky claims deliberate Russian attack on train at Poland border
en.summary: Ukraine's president stated on social media that Russia deliberately targeted a train near the Polish border.

stories.title: Venezia 83, Leone d'oro per il miglior film a "Woman Unknown". Premio speciale della regia a "Naza

en.title: Venice 83, Golden Lion for Best Film awarded to "Woman Unknown". Special directing prize to "Naza"
en.summary: At the Venice Film Festival, "Woman Unknown" won the Golden Lion for best film, while Mathilde Arcel and John Malkovich received acting awards for their respective roles.

stories.title: Emma Bonino, il feretro accolto dal picchetto d'onore in Campidoglio

en.title: Emma Bonino, casket received by honor guard at the Capitoline
en.summary: A funeral chapel was set up in Rome for the prominent Radical leader, with the mayor and party officials present to receive her casket.

stories.title: Emma Bonino, aperta la camera ardente: sul feretro la bandiera Ue

en.title: Emma Bonino, funeral chapel opened: EU flag on the casket
en.summary: The public can pay respects to the radical leader at a Rome funeral chapel on Sunday from noon to 7 p.m. and Monday from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.

stories.title: Raid russo vicino alla Polonia: droni colpiscono un camion e la locomotiva di un treno

en.title: Russian raid near Poland: drones strike truck and train locomotive
en.summary: Russian drone attacks hit infrastructure close to the Polish border, including a truck near a checkpoint and a passenger train locomotive in the Volyn region. Russia claims it targeted facilities used for military cargo transport from Europe.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina-Russia, news. Raid su treno al confine con Polonia, tra i passeggeri anche consiglieri di sicurezza di Italia, Germania, Regno Unito e Francia

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war, news. Train attack at Poland border with security advisers from Italy, Germany, UK and France among passengers
en.summary: A Russian attack targeted a service station at the Ukraine-Poland border with no reported casualties. Moscow states it struck railways transporting military supplies from Europe.

stories.title: Yemen, continua l’avanzata Houthi. Missili e droni contro una base militare saudita

en.title: Yemen, Houthi advance continues. Missiles and drones against a Saudi military base
en.summary: Houthi forces are advancing in Yemen and launching missile and drone attacks on Saudi military installations. An Iranian merchant vessel was rammed in the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in one death and three injuries.

stories.title: Azioni di guerra guidate da Ia, Anthropic: “Dobbiamo rallentare lo sviluppo”. Musk e Altman: giusto. Trump: “Forze negative”

en.title: AI-guided warfare, Anthropic: "We must slow development". Musk and Altman agree; Trump calls it "negative forces"
en.summary: Anthropic's CEO issued a strong warning about AI development risks for humanity, drawing agreement from Musk and Altman, while Trump dismissed the concerns as negative influence.

stories.title: Progetti speciali e nuove giostre, Zamperla punta ai 130 milioni di fatturato

en.title: Special projects and new rides, Zamperla targets 130 million in revenue
en.summary: Zamperla, a company founded in 1966 that designs and manufactures amusement park attractions, aims to reach 130 million euros in revenue through new projects and rides.

stories.title: Stress emergente, l’Aidp in prima linea

en.title: Emerging stress, Aidp in the front line
en.summary: Aidp is addressing the issue of return-to-work stress, which remains under-explored in established workplace practices but is widely felt in companies. The organization has begun developing solutions to tackle this concern.

stories.title: Alberto Fassi: «Per fare impresa, non smettere mai di sognare»

en.title: Alberto Fassi: "To do business, never stop dreaming"
en.summary: Legami founder Alberto Fassi discusses his entrepreneurial vision and two special projects: the Dreamland natural park and the book "We are dreamers."

stories.title: Ex Ilva Taranto: piano governativo a fasi per gestire lo stop all’area a caldo e le ripercussioni occupazionali

en.title: Ex Ilva Taranto: government plan in phases to manage the hot area shutdown and employment repercussions
en.summary: Following a Milan Court of Appeal order issued on September 11, the hot section of the former Ilva steel plant in Taranto must cease operations by end of October, prompting a phased government management plan for the shutdown and its employment consequences.

en.title: Production advancing slowly in Lombardy
en.summary: Lombardy's economy showed industrial production growth of 0.1% on a quarterly basis in the second trimester, marking the sixth consecutive advance in an ongoing recovery.
